findings.quote: The indole from 4773-41, 1-bromo-3-methoxybenzenee,Pd2(dba)3, JohnPhos and KOtBu were dissolved in toluene.
findings.message: The Add steps capture reagent charging but not the explicitly reported dissolution in toluene.

findings.quote: ~65% conversion was observed on NMR*(see attached NMR).
findings.message: The plan omits the reported NMR monitoring result after heating. This observation does not establish an isolated yield.

As already noted in uncertainties, r1 reportedly identifies sodium tert-butoxide, whereas the source specifies potassium tert-butoxide. The executable reagent assignment remains inconsistent; a correct replacement identifier cannot be determined from the supplied information.
